description_ru: Элювиальные отложения. Глыбы, отломы, щебень, пески, супеси (до 2 м)
note: GGK-200/2 O-57-V,VI (g. Chankolyap), West Kamchatka series, Quaternary map 2nd ed., RASTER = geokniga 2000x1440 px PREVIEW (~60 m/px; no full-resolution scan on geokniga); units from the separate legend JPG o-57-vviql.jpg; fills = MAP tints: legend swatch -> map full RGB affine fitted on 13 pairs sampled inside labelled polygons (median residual 3.5 dE), paired units take their own map tint, all refined on the face (r 3, cap 4 dE); fills = MAP tints (13 units sampled on the face, 7 by a legend->map affine fit, median residual 3.5 dE); same-colour merges (dry run 54-100 % ambiguous): cH+d,sH (C, ice_rich left blank), dH+dlH (C), gIII4+gH (T), pH+a,pH (F); the sea (Shelikhov Bay) is mapped as mH on the sheet and is classified mH (no separate water tint); labels are at the limit of legibility at 60 m/px, so the pink C units and fIII2/fIII4 were matched by tint, checked on readable labels; extraction: corners = inner neatline edge fitted along the four sides, --no-snap
